dimensions.taskCorrectness: Search name/SKU, combine all filters, edit/save/cancel, validation, permission restrictions; observed interactions, not appearance.
dimensions.componentAppropriateness: Table supports comparison, filters expose scope, editor fits task; actions and restrictions understandable.
dimensions.informationHierarchy: Primary task/action, title, results and metadata distinct; long names legible.
dimensions.visualComposition: Alignment, spacing, balance and content density across actual rendered viewports; no automated aesthetic score.
dimensions.responsiveUsability: 375/768/1440: page overflow, readable collection, reachable controls and editor; scrolling containment when used.
dimensions.accessibility: Semantic structure, accessible names, visible focus, keyboard operation and announcements; no conformance claim from static checks.
dimensions.stateRecovery: Rendered loading/empty/error; clear filters/retry; edit errors preserve input; unsaved warning and save acknowledgement.
dimensions.brandConsistency: Preserves fixed green/neutral tokens, consistent typography, controls and surfaces across states.

interpretation: Report dimensions separately with evidence and limitations. No aggregate winner required. One run per arm, no statistical or causal superiority claim. Evaluator knows conditions; aesthetic review is subjective. Failed tooling produces missing evidence, never a fabricated score.
